note: Runnable example games. Pika Studio copies one into the workspace with Pika: New Game from Example. s.json checksums are issued when a pack is published through the Pika platform; Studio neither creates nor checks them.

examples.name: Button Stress Test
examples.summary: Three-button input and the Text pool. The lightest example, no codec needed: a good starting point.

examples.name: Font Demo
examples.summary: Text with runtime TTF fonts at several sizes, and glyph coverage per font.

examples.name: Voice Probe
examples.summary: Voice keyword spotting probe: keyword list limits, on_voice_event handling and connection latency. Needs a voice server (Pika: Configure Voice ASR Server) or a robot.

examples.name: Pick a Word (demo + Lua pair)
examples.summary: Reference pair for the demo-to-Lua workflow: the Lua port of the kit demo in kit/template/index.html. Cursor over three cards, confirm, frame swap, tween, recorded voice lines.
